fact: As of December 2024 Madagascar is linked by four submarine cables, LION and LION2 (Orange), EASSy via Toliara, METISS in service since March 2021 via Fort Dauphin, and 2Africa landed at Mahajanga in February 2023 with 180 Tbps nominal capacity.
title: CABLES SOUS-MARINS | En attendant le « T4 »
